spec.name: BTS-SBOM app service
honestyContract: absence of evidence is not a pass (verification null = could not check)
the analysed origin is never modified; pushes and patches happen only behind explicit flags and human approval
SKIP and NOT RUN are never counted as PASS
existing API return values, status codes and CLI arguments only gain, never change

commands.build: python -X utf8 -m compileall -q bts_sbom_app bts_sbom tools

azure.hosting: App Service (Linux container + staging slot), see infra/main.bicep and docs/adr/ADR-0016
azure.pipeline: .github/workflows/deploy_azure.yml (workflow_dispatch only; OIDC login, no client secrets)
azure.devEnvironment: DEV_BASE_URL env var; unset = verify-dev is NOT RUN (exit 2), never a pass

llm.provider: EXAONE API (default k-exaone_v2.5); cloud mode keeps it off unless BTS_SBOM_CLOUD_LLM=1

notes: deploy_dev has never been executed (no Azure subscription in the writing environment) - it stays NOT RUN until someone runs azd with a real environment
every price in docs/cost_assumptions.json is null until a human fills it from the Azure pricing calculator
known unverified Azure facts are listed in the implementation brief appendix 1b and the ADRs (확인 필요)
